tooltip.golem_logix.guide_book: Illustrated occult tome detailing all logistics schematics and rituals.
tooltip.golem_logix.flattened_iron_core: Heavy cast iron logic circuit squashed under an anvil.
tooltip.golem_logix.flattened_copper_mat: Micro-grooved conductive matrix extracted by blunt mechanical impact.
tooltip.golem_logix.flattened_cryo_subst: Brittle frost crystal substrate infused with chilled channel logic.
tooltip.golem_logix.imploded_wither_plas: A collapsed singularity that still remembers the Wither.
tooltip.golem_logix.interdimensional_occ: Infinite occult gateway bridging network access across all dimensions.
tooltip.golem_logix.creative_source_jar: Endless Source reservoir for testing and creative apparatus.
tooltip.golem_logix.mana_saturator: A magic anvil: put an iron block, a copper block or packed ice on it and forge it with the Forge Hammer (left-click). Upgrade it into the 3x3x2 multiblock — casings, an End Rod and a dense pipe around it — to awaken the forging golem and get twice the plates.
tooltip.golem_logix.atlas_core: Crown of the 3x3x4 Atlas Array: mind of the network, the only block that drains Source.
tooltip.golem_logix.cable_bushing: Base of the Atlas Array: one bushing = one line of 64 channels leading out to pipes and devices.
tooltip.golem_logix.dense_frost_pipe: Dense packed frost conduit carrying 64 channels.
tooltip.golem_logix.copper_drive_bay: A 2x2 cabinet holding 10 cassettes with spinning reels. Copper golems scurry behind the glass.
tooltip.golem_logix.analog_terminal: Green-phosphor CRT display for accessing network storage.
tooltip.golem_logix.crafting_terminal: Analog storage monitor equipped with manual 3x3 workbench relays.
tooltip.golem_logix.pattern_encoder: Perforates recipe blueprints onto pure copper cards.
tooltip.golem_logix.pattern_provider: Stamping gateway for punched cards: feeds crafting batches into adjacent processing machinery.
tooltip.golem_logix.cryo_calculator: Chilled arithmetic matrix determining crafting recipe trees.
tooltip.golem_logix.cooling_coprocessor: Speeds up an adjacent Cryo-Calculator; on a roof grille of the Mana Saturator speeds up the golem.
tooltip.golem_logix.vacuum_import_bus: A turbine funnel that vacuums items from a container into the network.
tooltip.golem_logix.injector_export_bus: A steel nozzle that pushes the chosen items into a container.
tooltip.golem_logix.periscope_storage_bu: Occult crystal monocle that peers into chests to index them as network memory.
tooltip.golem_logix.eternal_frost_resona: Draws Source from the aether and sends it to every Portable Chronometer bound to its network.
tooltip.golem_logix.cryo_source_jar: Holds Source distilled by a Cryo-Distillation Tower and feeds the network like an Ars Nouveau jar. Two blocks high.
tooltip.golem_logix.cryo_distillation_to: Freezes the living warmth and chaos out of blood (Essentia Vitae from Neo Vitae) into Source for the jars beside it. Three blocks high.
tooltip.golem_logix.disk.no_type_limit: Pure count capacity — No item type restrictions
tooltip.golem_logix.punch_card.blank: Blank Copper Card (Encode in Pattern Encoder)
tooltip.golem_logix.chronometer.unbound_: Sneak-Right Click Central Core to bind.
message.golem_logix.chronometer.unbound: Chronometer is not bound to any Golem Logix core!

jei.golem_logix.info.cryo_jar: Holds 10 000 Source from a Cryo-Distillation Tower beside it. Put it against any block of the network, like an Ars Nouveau jar; the Saturator, the Forge Hammer and the Chronometer drink from it too.
message.golem_logix.wither_imploded: Nascent Wither collapsed under the anvil into Imploded Plasma!

message.golem_logix.no_core: This network has no Atlas Core! Connect the terminal to a core with pipes or bushings.
message.golem_logix.no_power: The Atlas Core has no Source! Feed the network with a Source Jar or a Creative Source Jar next to any network block.

gui.golem_logix.calc.idle: Idle. Order crafting from a terminal.

subtitles.golem_logix.tube_scurry: Snow golems scurry in the tube
